title: SentinelOne Wins SIEM Solution of the Year in CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards 2026
summary: Award recognizes Singularity AI, SentinelOne’s foundational offering to help SecOps teams deliver on the vision for the Autonomous SOC
body_markdown:
*Award recognizes Singularity AI, SentinelOne’s foundational offering to help SecOps teams deliver on the vision for the Autonomous SOC*


**MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif. – October 8, 2026 –**[SentinelOne®](https://www.sentinelone.com/) (NYSE: S), the AI Security leader, today announced it has been named “SIEM Solution of the Year” in the CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards 2026 program. This award recognizes Singularity AI SIEM, SentinelOne’s innovative data offering for helping security teams defenders detect, investigate and stop threats through the use of real-time security data and automated workflows.


AI empowered attackers, rogue and malicious agents, and a new, expanded AI attack surface have shown the limits of legacy SOC defenses like SIEM and SOAR. SentinelOne provides security teams with a modern, autonomous foundation to combat these rapidly evolving risks, head on. A foundational component for realizing the benefits of a truly autonomous SOC, SentinelOne’s AI SIEM was built from the ground up to ingest, index, and analyze telemetry across seamless, scalable AI data pipelines. Instead of adding legacy automation on top of fragmented datasets, SentinelOne turns the volume and complexity that once hid attackers into a decisive operating advantage for defenders.


“ AI has not only empowered attackers, but has become an attack surface in its own right, creating threats that quickly outscale and outpace legacy defenses


,” said Chris Corde, Chief Product Officer of SentinelOne. “ Being named SIEM Solution of the Year validates SentinelOne’s approach to AI-powered, autonomous defense. From embracing a broader collection of enterprise data through smart AI data pipelines, to scaling and automation investigations and response through agentic workflows, our goal is to give defenders the modern foundation needed to reimagine the SOC for the AI era.


”


SentinelOne built AI SIEM for where security operations are heading: an autonomous yet auditable closed loop where every signal is observed, every threat investigated, and every validated incident resolved at machine speed. Getting there starts with the data. Every record stays instantly searchable for up to seven years, giving defenders the full visibility to detect hidden threats that fragmented tools miss. From there, no-code Hyperautomation takes on the repetitive work at machine speed, within team-defined guardrails, so the alerts that reach an analyst are the ones that need human judgement. And for those alerts, SentinelOne’s Purple AI® is already working the case alongside the analyst, summarizing what happened, answering plain-language questions, and recommending the next steps, so an analyst at any experience level can investigate with confidence.


The CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards program honors the top companies, technologies, and products in the global information security market, chosen from a large pool of nominations from security vendors worldwide.


Learn more about SentinelOne’s AI SIEM at[sentinelone.com/platform/ai-cybersecurity/](https://www.sentinelone.com/platform/ai-cybersecurity/) .


**About CyberSecurity Breakthrough**


**** CyberSecurity Breakthrough is an independent organization that recognizes the top companies, technologies, and products in the global information security market. The program honors innovation, leadership, and success in cybersecurity.


**About SentinelOne**


SentinelOne (NYSE: S) is the leader in AI security, setting the standard for using AI and automation to give defenders a decisive operating advantage. Built for those who secure our world, its platform delivers unified coverage across endpoints, identity, cloud, and AI. Powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence, SentinelOne stops attacks at machine speed, reducing risk and delivering clarity and control to stay one step ahead. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, with teams worldwide, SentinelOne protects nearly one-fifth of the Fortune 500 and hundreds of Global 2000 enterprises. From Main Street to Wall Street, the world’s most critical organizations trust SentinelOne with their security.
